name: Niku Mesu R30 ~Nikuyoku ni Ochita Mesu-tachi~
original_name: 肉牝R30 ～肉欲に堕ちた牝たち～
source: Teshirogi Naoki was raised in a wealthy family, but his family fell apart due to his parents' divorce and a power struggle within the clan, causing him to become a shut-in for over 10 years. On the verge of turning 30, he receives a maid from his father and is told that if he can protect his virginity, he can become the head of the clan. Various women target Naoki's virginity, but he fends off their temptations with the help of the maid and becomes the head of the clan. However, whether he can regain his once happy days remains unknown.
translation: 手代木直树出生于富裕的家庭，但父母离婚、家族内部争权，使家庭分崩离析，也让他闭门不出长达十余年。即将年满30岁时，父亲给他送来一名女仆，并告诉他：只要守住自己的童贞，就可以成为家主。各式各样的女人盯上了直树的童贞，但他在女仆的帮助下抵御诱惑，最终成为家主。然而，他能否找回曾经幸福的日子，仍是未知数。
